decisions.rationale: row_count 13014 ≈ airport_code distinct_count 3 times observed_hour_utc distinct_count 4341 (13023), and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, supporting this composite as the row-identifying grain pending deterministic confirmation.
wind_gust_mph is null in 74.6% of rows, pressure_mb in 11.5%, wind_dir_degrees in 1.7%, and wind_speed_mph in 0.02%, so these are retained as nullable rather than required.

airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, and airport_longest_runway_ft each take only 2-3 distinct values matching the 3 airports, indicating they are denormalized dimension attributes repeated per observation row.

captured_at has only 3 distinct values clustered within 2 seconds of each other despite is_airbyte_metadata being false in the profile, suggesting it records pipeline capture time rather than an observed weather attribute; flagged for reviewer confirmation.

purpose: This table holds hourly weather observations for three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, combining atmospheric measurements (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) with denormalized airport dimension attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway).
usage: Read at the grain of one row per airport per UTC hour (airport_code, observed_hour_utc). Consumers must handle nulls in wind_dir_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph (sparse, up to 74.6% null), and pressure_mb, since these were not always recorded. Airport dimension columns repeat per row rather than being normalized into a separate table.
limitations: The profile could only support the declared grain through row-count arithmetic (3 airports × 4341 UTC hours ≈ 13014 rows) and a 0.0 duplicate_row_rate; a deterministic grain measurement should confirm it before enforcement. wind_gust_mph is null in 74.6% of rows, pressure_mb in 11.5%, wind_dir_degrees in 1.7%, and wind_speed_mph in 0.02%, so these columns carry no guarantee of presence. captured_at is not flagged is_airbyte_metadata in the profile but its narrow 3-value range of timestamps seconds apart suggests it is a pipeline ingestion marker rather than an observed attribute, and a reviewer should confirm its treatment. visibility_miles values appear rounded or capped to a fixed set of 20 values, which may reflect sensor reporting granularity rather than a true closed business category.
